prompt.en: A waterfall program shows flat-topped receive tones because the interface input is being overdriven, but the RF signal on the air is normal. Which change is most likely to help decoding?

text.en: Reduce the receiver-audio or interface input level before software samples it
Raise the AF output further so the clipped waveform fills more of the sound-card range
Adjust the push-to-talk control line because receive clipping is caused by transmit switching
Change the transmit playback level because receive clipping is fixed on the transmit-audio path

explanation.en: This is receive-audio level trouble at the interface input. Reducing the audio before conversion keeps the samples from clipping; transmit power, PTT control, and supply filtering do not repair an overdriven audio input.

prompt.en: A regulator has 19 V input, 13.8 V output, and 3 A load. The installed heat sink is rated for about 10 W in this exercise. What decision follows?

text.en: It must handle about 15.6 W, so the stated 10 W heat sink is not enough
It must handle about 5.2 W, so the 10 W heat sink has plenty of margin
It must handle about 13.8 W, because only output voltage makes heat
It must handle about 57 W, because input voltage is multiplied by load current

explanation.en: The regulator drops 19 V - 13.8 V = 5.2 V. At 3 A that is 5.2 V x 3 A = 15.6 W, which exceeds the stated 10 W heat-sink capacity for this exercise.

prompt.en: Spot the error in this safety plan for a qualified technician preparing to troubleshoot ripple in a mains-powered linear supply.

text.en: Unplug the supply and follow the service procedure before handling internal parts
Verify stored capacitor voltage with a meter after the discharge step
Short the main filter capacitor with a screwdriver so it discharges instantly
Use a proper resistor discharge tool or built-in bleeder path where specified

explanation.en: A screwdriver short can cause a dangerous arc and damage parts. Safe service uses de-energizing, controlled discharge, verification, and qualified procedures.
